empty: No rooms in the queue. Tap a room below to add it.
drag: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow keys
no_rooms: No rooms available. Choose rooms in the integration options.
no_mapping: No rooms yet: map the vacuum's segments to areas (vacuum → settings → map areas to segments). If the segments only show numbers, name the rooms in the vacuum's app first.
choose_entity: Choose the room queue of your vacuum. No room queue yet? Set up the Vacuum Room Queue integration first.
error_did_not_start: The vacuum did not start cleaning.
error_command_failed: The vacuum did not accept the command.
